data.exact_reserve_text: The syndicate has strengthened prior year reserves by $1.4m during 2018 (2017: release of $26.5m).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of $46.9 million in 2018, calculated from the gross claims development triangle. This represents a 12.16% release relative to opening gross claims outstanding. The narrative on page 1 states a net strengthening of $1.4 million for prior year reserves, indicating a significant difference between gross and net movements. The 2016 year of account declared a loss, while the 2017 year of account is forecast to close with a return, suggesting mixed development across prior years.
